trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to Img.Upscaler
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm receiving lifetime access to an AI upscaler that works as promised, and the generic right to change parts of the service does not specifically cancel the lifetime deal.

exhibits.quote: We may update, improve, limit, suspend, or discontinue parts of the service as needed for product, security, operational, or legal reasons.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because the vendor reserves the right to limit, suspend or discontinue parts of the service.

exhibits.quote: Because it's an amazing value to have lifetime access to a true AI upscaler and it works the way they say.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms they received lifetime access to a true AI upscaler that works as promised.

exhibits.quote: Taking all this into consideration and given that this is an unlimited lifetime deal, I am satisfied with my purchase
exhibits.argument: Buyer describes the purchase as an unlimited lifetime deal and expresses satisfaction.

trials.claim: Unlimited access to upscale as many photos as you want
trials.claimQuote: Unlimited access to upscale as many photos as you want.
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms unlimited access and the vendor describes a no-credits-limit option; a limit of 5 images per batch limits batch size, not the total number of photos you can upscale over time.

exhibits.quote: You can only upload less than 5 images at a time.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited upscaling is undermined by a strict per-batch upload cap reported by a buyer.

exhibits.quote: Could be a great tool but the "batch processing" is max 5 images.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited access is contradicted by batch processing being capped at 5 images.

exhibits.quote: For businesses and production workflows that need no credits limit.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states its high-volume plan has no credits limit, supporting unlimited use.

exhibits.quote: they are giving you unlimited access to both upscaler and creative upscaler and they work really really great.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms receiving unlimited access to the upscaler that works well.
